text:
Key decisions (RADIO)
- Server-side sort, filter, paging; the
  URL holds the view (shareable)
- Validate CSV in a Web Worker, show row
  errors before upload
- Long imports run as jobs with progress
- Role guards in the UI, real checks on
  the server
- Every change is audited
